title: Split-Zero cohomology: dual reconstruction and kernel-residual row energies

source_cuts.scope: Complete 293-page cumulative Split-Zero reader with 12 complete new proof bodies and 241 tagged equations: RCF1-15, RCM1-27, DNE1-15, PEC1-32, ACR1-23, LBRE1-18, ASR1-18, PBR1-19, LJR1-33, LRR1-4, HJR1-31 and HCR1-6. The original Gamma dual metric retains the entire lower evaluation space, conductor and induced reference metrics. Exact kernel quotients, complementary residual restrictions, low-space isometry and exceptional period cases remain. The low-jet reconstruction includes its full quotient Jacobian and remainder; the recurrence-compatible later jets preserve both Schur denominators. The actual row energies x_M and y_M allocate increments as log(1+x_M) to the residual and log(1+y_M/(1+x_M)) to the kernel. The complete common low-window term cancels under the original four signs. The total row sum is evaluated; the individual kernel/residual allocation coefficient remains uncomputed. Both low contributions, source orders s=1,k, finite unequal errors and original arithmetic action budget are retained. Prior full proofs and formalization sources remain at their stated scope. SIC/NG and active allocation work are outside this sealed cut. No terminal theorem or programme-completion claim. Completed owner acceptance is reused, not repeated. The final reader source matches its three-pass build and accepted visual receipt: all 293 pages were rendered, every footer checked, and no off-page text spans or reader diagnostics remain. The owner records inherited body matches and the exact fresh-page review; this is not a claim of fresh individual inspection of every inherited page. Complete receiving sources built through three passes to 401 and 389 pages; their PDFs are build checks, not additional delivered visually accepted artifacts. Complete provider proofs, mathematical reviews, exact reversible source transports and prior source identities are preserved in file11. Broad supplementary closure is provenance only: mathematical acceptance applies to the explicitly listed providers and receipt scopes. No new local proof, PDF, source-preservation or Lean review.
